notes:
BUILD 74
- Engines have to be started. R in the seat turns the key: the starter cranks for a second and the engine catches, or coughs and dies if its parts are badly worn (try again). R again switches it off. Works the same in every car, the bike and all three helicopters, and it tells you why if it will not start.
- Shooting from a car or the minicopter is steady now: being driven no longer counts as running and jumping.
